summary: Preserve the ordinary CommonJS-turn ordering where the next-tick queue drains before Promise/queueMicrotask jobs.

requirements.scheduling_context: ordinary JavaScript turn, not already executing a microtask

target.notes: Use the Node-compatible event-loop runtime; do not map ordering to arbitrary Task/ThreadPool scheduling.

semantics.ordering: nextTick callback before V8 microtask callbacks queued in the same ordinary CommonJS turn
semantics.queues: nextTick queue drains first; microtask queue drains immediately after

caveats: This ordering must not be generalized to code already running inside a microtask.
ES module top-level evaluation has different ordering because it executes as part of the microtask queue.

tests.name: CJS nextTick precedes Promise and queueMicrotask
tests.expected_behavior: in CommonJS prints tick, promise, micro

tests.name: microtask context is excluded
tests.expected_behavior: this rule does not apply because scheduling occurs while draining microtasks
